name: Rp2 Ble Tracker → On Ble Advertise
description: An automation to perform when a BLE advertising packet is received. Optionally filtered to a list of `mac_address`es. A variable `x` of type <APIClass text="ble_device_base::ESPBTDevice" path="ble_device_base::ESPBTDevice" /> is passed to the automation for use in lambdas. The shared trigger classes and variables are identical to [ESP32 BLE Tracker](https://esphome.io/components/esp32_ble_tracker/#esp32_ble_tracker-on_ble_advertise).
